items.title: Unlocking the Power of Digital Twins with Greg Biegel
items.summary:
Join author Greg Biegel in this engaging video as he introduces his groundbreaking book, "Digital Twins in Action," now available in MEAP from Manning Publications. Delve into the world of digital twins—a revolutionary concept where a software-based replica mirrors real-world systems, empowering you to operate, monitor, and maintain them remotely.

In this video, Greg outlines how modern technologies like IoT sensors, 3D visualizations, simulation algorithms, and AI converge to create an impressive digital twin environment. Discover how these tools allow for innovation without the risks and costs of real-world experimentation!

What you'll learn:
- How to define clear business objectives for building a digital twin
- Steps to create accurate digital representations of physical systems
- Techniques for integrating computer vision, OCR, and generative AI with 3D geometric models
- Streaming IoT sensor data into your digital twin
- Employing machine learning and agentic AI for insightful analysis and smart decision-making

Drawing from over 20 years of experience in developing comprehensive digital twin platforms, Greg shares real-world insights and practical strategies throughout the video. "Digital Twins in Action" serves as your hands-on guide to building effective digital twins, including creating a home-scale twin from scratch and utilizing cutting-edge technologies to generate 3D models and extract meaningful insights.

Save 40% with code WATCHBIEGEL40 at https://hubs.la/Q03VCxCy0

This video is a must-watch for software developers and machine learning engineers eager to elevate their understanding of digital twins to new heights. Whether you're well-versed in physical systems engineering or just starting your journey, Greg’s expertise provides valuable knowledge for anyone interested in this transformative technology.

Don't miss your chance to learn from an industry expert—watch now and start your journey into the fascinating world of digital twins!

For more information about the book, visit the Manning Publications website.

#digitaltwin #iot

items.title: Inside Quantum Algorithms: Speedups, Hybrids & the Future
items.summary:
Explore the podcast → www.ibm.com/think/podcast/the-coherence-times

What are algorithms, and why are they so important to computing? In this episode of The Coherence Times, we dive into the fascinating world of quantum algorithms and explore their complicated relationship with their classical counterparts. From the early “vacuum tube days” of quantum computational theory  to the sophisticated hybrid quantum-classical methods that are paving the way to quantum advantage, discover how researchers design, test, and validate new algorithms—and get a glimpse of what the future of computation could look like as they scale.

The opinions expressed in this podcast are solely those of the participants and do not necessarily reflect the views of IBM or any other organization or entity. 

Check out the IBM Quantum Platform → https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com 
Quantum Advantage Tracker here → https://quantum-advantage-tracker.github.io

items.title: LlamaSheets | AI Parsing and Extraction for Spreadsheets
items.summary:
Introducing LlamaSheets — The AI-Powered Spreadsheet Extraction API (Beta)

LlamaSheets is a new LlamaCloud API that automatically transforms complex, messy spreadsheets into clean, structured, AI-ready data. Using advanced semantic analysis and a multi-stage extraction pipeline, LlamaSheets identifies tables, preserves hierarchical headers, interprets formatting, and outputs typed Parquet datasets for analytics, agents, and automation workflows.

- LlamaCloud Sign-up/Sign-in: https://www.llamaindex.ai/signup
- LlamaSheets Docs: https://developers.llamaindex.ai/python/cloud/llamasheets/getting_started/
